topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well, now, I heard you found out your friend's not been honest about their work. Ain't that a nail in the coffin of trust? But you know, the earth forgives the farmer even when he tills too deep or sows too late. Maybe this is just a storm that'll pass, and the soil of your friendship can still grow good crops, if you tend to it right. Folks make mistakes, and sometimes the truth is like a stubborn root, hard to pull up. But if you can find it, and you can forgive, well, that’s the grace of the saints, isn’t it? May your heart be as patient as the fields that wait for spring.
